description: This is a PHP source file for the 'Subscription' controller in the admin area of an OpenCart-based e-commerce platform. It manages CRUD operations, listing, viewing, and interaction with subscription entities, including handling subscription histories, orders, logs, and related actions.

classes.name: Subscription
classes.description: Controller class handling subscription management in the admin panel, including listing, viewing, editing, deleting subscriptions, managing their histories, orders, logs, and API interactions.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point for the subscription list and management page. Loads language, sets up breadcrumbs, filters, and passes data to view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles AJAX requests to return the list of subscriptions in the admin interface.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates the HTML table listing subscriptions with filtering, sorting, pagination, and links for viewing details.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Displays detailed information about a specific subscription, including customer data, products, addresses, statuses, log, and related entities.

methods.name: call
methods.description: Creates a storefront API call, generating a signed request to interact with the frontend store, for example, to fetch real-time subscription data.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected subscriptions, with permission checks, and returns JSON response.

methods.name: history
methods.description: Loads the subscription history view or data for a specific subscription.

methods.name: getHistory
methods.description: Retrieves and formats the history entries for a subscription, including pagination.

methods.name: addHistory
methods.description: Adds a new status update or comment into the subscription's history with notification handling.

methods.name: order
methods.description: Loads the associated orders for a subscription.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Retrieves associated orders with pagination for a specific subscription.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Loads the log entries related to the subscription.

methods.name: getLog
methods.description: Retrieves and formats the logs for a subscription with pagination.
